sourceNote: ronaldo7.net publishes one page per Ronaldo season. Where the page lists each goal on its own, the entry names the opponent, the date, the score, the competition and a description, and carries that goal's own video. The videos are third-party uploads on YouTube and Dailymotion; they are linked and embedded, never re-hosted. The season pages are the source of the video, the dates and the descriptions.

goals.description: Ronaldo gets his first of the season with a classic header, after a good cross from Angel Di María.
A rebound from a Benzema shot allows Ronaldo to easily score and put Real Madrid on the lead.
Ronaldo scored the third Real Madrid goal on the night after a header assist from Isco and from a very short range.
Sergio Ramos header got stopped by Muslera, but Ronaldo finished it off easily from a rebound.
Cristiano Ronaldo gets past two defenders and then still manages to create space for a left-foot strike to score a terrific goal.
The first penalty-kick Real Madrid earned this season was succesfully taken by Cristiano Ronaldo. No chances for the goalkeeper...
Terrific backheel goal from Cristiano Ronaldo, as he answered to a low cross sent by Sami Khedira.
The first free-kick goal of the season went right through a packed wall of Elche's men and stopped only at the back of the net.
Ronaldo didn't seem to have felt any pressure when he scored this vital penalty-kick that rescued the 3 points to Real Madrid.
Ronaldo broke the deadlock in the Bernabéu, after answering a Marcelo long cross with a text-book header.
Another header goal for Ronaldo from short-range, this time after a responding to an outstanding rabona cross from Angel Di María.
A terrific last-minute winner scored from Cristiano Ronaldo that has allowed Real Madrid to come off with the 3 points from Levante's stadium.
Gareth Bale earned a penalty-kick already inside added time and Cristiano Ronaldo seized the opportunity to extend his goalscoring record.
The usual drill: Di María assists and Ronaldo finishes it off with class, after going around Gianluigi Buffon.
A flawlessly penalty-kick taken by Ronaldo sent Real Madrid right into the lead for the 2nd time on the night, allowing the home side to collect the 3 points.
Ronaldo opens his personal count with a powerful penalty-kick and leaving no chances to the goalkeeper even though he guessed the right side.
A right-foot first touch finish from Ronaldo, after a low cross coming from the right by Gareth Bale.
Ronaldo cuts inside and sees his shot getting slightly deflected before going above Sevilla's goalkeeper head and hitting the back of the net.
Great counter-attack goal, with Ronaldo doing a nutmeg to a defender before beating Rayo's goalkeeper.
Excellent job and assist from Gareth Bale, who delivered a perfect low cross for Ronaldo to finish from a favorable position.
Karim Benzema leaves it over to Cristiano Ronaldo and CR7 seizes his opportunity to score in Turin with a good finish against Buffon.
Great finish from Ronaldo, after receiving a perfect pass from Benzema and sets it up for his right foot.
Ronaldo scores his second on the afternoon after converting a penalty-kick to the middle of the goal, deep in the first-half.
Ronaldo scores his 2nd goal from a free-kick this season, this time leaving the goalkeeper nailed on the ground and staring at the ball.
Ronaldo responds to a cross from Isco with a great left touch finish, sending Real Madrid to an early lead in the game.
An easy tap-in goal for Ronaldo, assisted by a header from Pepe, already inside the penalty area.
A slight header deflection to a cross made by Angel Di María was enough to put his name on the scoreboard and help Real Madrid winning another game.
Ronaldo scores his first goal of 2014 after meeting and finishing a low cross from Carvajal, already inside Celta de Vigo's box.
Gareth Bale assists Cristiano Ronaldo for his second of the night and his 400th career goal. Another big landmark for the Portuguese legend.
Ronaldo scored the opener in the Reyno de Navarra, but not without counting with a big mistake from the goalkeeper when trying to stop his free-kick.
Ronaldo scores the opener with a powerful rocket from an open play down in the center of the pitch. Surely one of CR7's best goals this season!
Great foot work from Cristiano Ronaldo, before striking the ball with his left-foot and put Real Madrid on the lead!
Ronaldo breaks the deadlock from the penalty-kick spot, leaving no chances to Atletico Madrid's goalkeeper!
And yet again, Ronaldo scores a very similar goal to his first, once more from the penalty-kick mark!
Ronaldo takes on a defender, does three stepovers before getting past him and finishes it off brilliantly with his left foot!
Last minute of the game and Ronaldo still shows he has enough gas tank to do a final sprint, dribble the goalkeeper and slot the ball in.
A great right-foot strike from Ronaldo equalizes the game at the Calderón and delivers Real Madrid a highly precious point for the title run.
Ronaldo responds to a Di María corner-kick with a powerful header and sends Real Madrid into an early lead against Levante.
A narrow win to Real Madrid, delivered once again by Cristiano Ronaldo, with a superb right-foot strike while cutting inside from the left.
Great job from Gareth Bale close to the right edge of Schalke's box, who assisted Ronaldo for an easy right footed tap-in.
Brilliant counter-attack from Cristiano Ronaldo, who didn't show any fear of taking on whoever stepped in front of him before scoring his second of the night.
Ronaldo converts a penalty-kick in the Clasico against Barcelona, after drawing a foul on Daniel Alves within the first minutes of the second half.
Real Madrid takes the lead from a Cristiano Ronaldo free-kick goal, that still took a deflection on the wall before going into the back of the net.
Cristiano Ronaldo and Bale show a great understanding on the pitch and the Portuguese finishes off a beautiful play with a right-foot strike.
Cristiano Ronaldo picks up a pass from Modric and sends it past Borussia Dortmund's goalkeeper, with a nifty 2-touch skill.
What a way to break the deadlock, with a terrific strike from near one of the edges of the box that the goalkeeper could only follow with his eyes...
Ronaldo does it again and still in the same game! Another superb strike from outside the box, this time even more stronger than the previous one. Screamer!
Great run from Gareth Bale who shows an incredibly generosity by assisting Ronaldo for the Portuguese to bury his first!
Cristiano Ronaldo seals another spectacular win and individual performance, this time with a free-kick goal beneath the Bayern Munich's wall.
A spectacular backheel goal from Ronaldo equalizes the game inside stoppage time and renews Real Madrid's hopes for still winning the title.
Ronaldo converts a penalty-kick to set the final score in 4-1 and confirm Real Madrid's 10th UEFA Champions League (La Décima).
